name: Fey Flicker
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature you can see within 30 feet deals damage to you.

---
As you get hurt, your body releases a glint of First World energy that overwhelms your foe. The triggering creature becomes Dazzled until the end of its next turn. The creature can use an Interact action to acclimate and remove the dazzled condition.
